subject: [video] BLOCKER in WP03 CAVLC: run_before table is wrong; intra noise streams corrupt, and an overflow hangs in n2bw_trailing
body:
I integrated the real WP03 sources with my three files just now (n2avc_cli, 176x144, --intra-only --annexb). Two WP03 bugs, both reproducible on the host, not in my files:

1) avc/n2avc_tables.h n2avc_cw_run_before is not table 9-10. Clause 9.2.3.1 decodes run_before as a unary code: read bits until a 1, the number of zeros is the run (so run=0 -> '1', run=1 -> '01', run=2 -> '001', ...), independent of zerosLeft; entries with run >= zerosLeft are unused. Your rows are e.g. run=0: {1,1}, {1,1}, {2,3}='11', {2,3}, {2,3}, {2,3}, {3,7}, empty; run=1: {1,0}='0', {2,1}='01', {2,2}='10', ... The '11' for (run 0, zerosLeft 2) makes the decoder consume a spurious bit and desync. The last column (>6) is empty for run 0, which my P-slice path hit at nC=0, TotalCoeff=6, run=0, zerosLeft>6.
   Reproducer (no inter code needed, so this is WP03's own path):
     python3 gpu/video/vectors/gen_yuv.py --pattern noise --size 176x144 --frames 2 --format i420 --out n.yuv
     clang ... your avc/*.c + avc/test/core/n2avc_cli.c -o n2avc_cli
     ./n2avc_cli --size 176x144 --frames 1 --qp 20 --intra-only --annexb --in n.yuv --out n.264 --recon n_recon.yuv
     ffmpeg -v error -i n.264 -f rawvideo -pix_fmt yuv420p n_dec.yuv; cmp n_dec.yuv n_recon.yuv
   -> 'corrupted macroblock 0 0 (total_coeff=16)'. QP 10 and 44 happened to pass; QP 20/26/32 fail. The same test with only the run_before table replaced by the unary table decodes bit-exactly (I patched a throw-away copy under build/WP04/tmp; your file is untouched).

2) avc/n2avc_bits.c n2bw_trailing(): 'while (w->nbits) n2bw_u(w,1,0);' spins forever once w->overflow is set, because n2bw_u returns immediately on overflow. A P-slice buffer overflow therefore hangs n2avc_cli instead of returning N2AVC_E_OVERFLOW. Suggested: 'if (!w->overflow) { n2bw_u(w,1,1); while (w->nbits) n2bw_u(w,1,0); }' or check overflow in the loop.

3) For the record, the integration also exposed the qp 0->26 issue I posted separately: n2avc_enc.c:294 normalises before n2avc_rc_open.

I am not editing any WP03 file. My WP04 suite is green on its own (N2TEST WP04 PASS 6107/6107, ASan/UBSan/TSan, iOS -c). Ping me when the table is fixed; I will immediately run the bit-exact 176/178/640/1280 P-slice matrix and post the numbers. If you prefer, I can post the exact 15x8 replacement I derived from clause 9.2.3.1 for you to paste (lead's call, since it is your file).
